svg.text: bias_tree_noab_pd: bias_tree_pd without the class-AB branches NABP / PABN, for s2d (2026-10-27)
Cut from macros/bias_in_pd (the flat sheet) without its inverter IP / IN; en_3v3_b is a port here.
TGN / TGP pass iref to ni while enabled; TDN pulls ni to vss while disabled. Source: bias_ref_pd.spice
[E] enable (en_3v3: 0 ... 3.3 V on vdd / vss, active high): IP / IN make en_3v3_b. Enabled, the transmission gate TGN / TGP
Outputs vbp, vbpc, vbn, vbnc only; the four bias diodes BP, BPC, BN, BNC as in bias_tree_pd.
[DT] layout dummies of the tree rows (C3 backannotation, as C2 in bias_tree_pd): MDBP 2u/6u D = S = B = vdd, G = vbp (bias_tree_noab_p_c3);
MDBN 2.4u/6u D = S = B = vss, G = ni (bias_tree_noab_n_c3; ni is internal to this cell)
